title: Xi Ties Predecessor’s Legacy to His Agenda as Global Risks Rise
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping invoked the legacy of his predecessor Jiang Zemin to advance his own economic and global policy agenda, warning of “high winds and rough waters” as China faces slowing growth and rising tensions abroad.

title: Goldman Says Markets Too Hawkish on Betting Fed Will Hike Rates
summary: Market bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes are still too aggressive given that inflation in the world’s biggest economy is cooling, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.

title: India Readies LPG Output Boost as Hormuz Uncertainty Lingers
summary: India has directed refiners to boost cooking gas production, seeking to bolster domestic supplies ahead of the upcoming festival season as uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz threatens imports.

title: Copper Heads Toward Record High on LME as Supply Tensions Build
summary: Copper rose toward a record, with a key price spread in London widening to unusual levels in a sign of intense competition for supply.

title: Dollar Weakens as Traders Pare Fed Rate-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
summary: The dollar fell against most of its major peers after weak US economic data reduced bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month.

title: Korea Eximbank to Lend $1 Billion to Glencore for Copper Supply
summary: Export-Import Bank of Korea will lend $1 billion to commodities giant Glencore Plc in exchange for copper supply to South Korean companies, as the country seeks to secure raw materials needed for the artificial intelligence boom.

title: Indonesian Developer Modernland Seeks Bond Restructuring Again

title: Japan’s Bond Yields Climb on BOJ Hike Bets, Fiscal Concerns
summary: Japan’s bonds fell on fiscal concerns and growing speculation that the Bank of Japan may raise interest rates in the coming months, pushing the 10-year yield to the highest since 1996.
